description:
Smart. Focused. Email.

Fast, cross-platform email designed to filter out the noise - so you can focus on what's important.
We've fixed several issues affecting Outlook and Microsoft 365 accounts, and improved Spark CLI reliability with Shared Inboxes.
- Fixed an issue where Outlook and Microsoft 365 accounts could stop syncing or fail to retrieve older messages after being reconnected.
- Improved search accuracy for Outlook and Microsoft 365 accounts, so results now reliably match your search query.
- Fixed an issue where attachments in Outlook and Microsoft 365 accounts sometimes didn't appear until you reopened the message.
- Fixed a bug where forwarding an email could duplicate its attachments.
- Fixed several issues where Spark CLI commands (listings, searches, and filters) could show missing, duplicate, or incorrect messages when working with Shared Inboxes.
- Fixed an issue where label and move actions could fail for Shared Inboxes accessed through the MCP integration.
- Support for ProtonMail Bridge accounts is back. Note that some advanced Spark features, like Send Later, aren't available for these accounts yet.
We're always here for you at support@sparkmailapp.com

P.S. If you encounter any issues with the automatic update, please use the following link to download the update manually:
https://downloads.sparkmailapp.com/Spark3/win/dist/3.30.4.140188/Spark.exe
